reviewNote: All 80 pairs checked in full for fish-request responses, repeated placeholders and voice, gamepad/advanced-game options, kitchen/bed conditions, session states, building-owner permissions and Beach Farm qualifications. Preserved exact control placeholders including the local-controller * marker and farm-description underscore. Item responses use case-safe wording for runtime noun labels. Complete final reread found no issue.

Beach Farm_Good foraging and fishing, and tons of open space. Sometimes, supply crates wash up on shore. However, sprinklers don't work in the sandy soil.
rows.translation: Plážová farma_Dobré podmínky pro sběr a rybaření a spousta volného místa. Občas moře na břeh vyplaví bedny se zásobami. V písčité půdě ale nefungují zavlažovače.
